title: Investment Counsel Inc. Sells 1,333 Shares of Apple (AAPL)
text:
Posted by Lisa Pomrenke on Mar 30th, 2018 // No Comments 
Investment Counsel Inc. lowered its position in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5.3% in the fourth quarter, according to its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 23,781 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,333 shares during the period. Apple makes up approximately 3.2% of Investment Counsel Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its 5th largest position. Investment Counsel Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $4,024,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also recently made changes to their positions in AAPL. Stonehearth Capital Management LLC increased its holdings in Apple by 19.1% in the 4th quarter. Stonehearth Capital Management LLC now owns 3,066 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $519,000 after purchasing an additional 491 shares during the last quarter. Colorado Capital Management Inc. increased its holdings in Apple by 7.7% in the 4th quarter. Colorado Capital Management Inc. now owns 10,193 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,725,000 after purchasing an additional 733 shares during the last quarter. KCS Wealth Advisory acquired a new stake in Apple in the 4th quarter valued at approximately $1,386,000. CMH Wealth Management LLC increased its holdings in Apple by 3.9% in the 4th quarter. CMH Wealth Management LLC now owns 31,232 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,380,000 after purchasing an additional 1,170 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Nadler Financial Group Inc. increased its holdings in Apple by 0.5% in the 4th quarter. Nadler Financial Group Inc. now owns 57,894 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,797,000 after purchasing an additional 305 shares during the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 61.35% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
Several analysts recently weighed in on AAPL shares. Vetr downgraded shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $178.34 target price for the company. in a report on Friday, December 1st. UBS set a $190.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, December 4th. Tigress Financial reiterated a “strong-buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, December 6th. KeyCorp reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $192.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, December 7th. Finally, Stifel Nicolaus reissued a “sell” rating and issued a $26.00 price target (up previously from $22.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, December 13th. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $202.62. In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available at this hyperlink . Insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. 
Shares of Apple stock opened at $167.78 on Friday. Apple has a 52-week low of $140.06 and a 52-week high of $183.50. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. The stock has a market cap of $844,721.69, a PE ratio of 17.24, a PEG ratio of 1.26 and a beta of 1.19. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the business posted $3.36 earnings per share. The business’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. equities analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
